intro.tagline: I build Laravel & React systems for finance and industry — and keep the IT behind them running.
intro.now: Building a reporting and digital subscriptions & redemptions solution for Alphavest Asset Management.

about.heading: About
about.title: Two hats, one owner — from server to interface.
about.p1: I hold a degree in Application Development Engineering (FST Tanger) and a Full Stack Developer certification from Webforce3. Since 2022, I've worked across four internships and my current role, building enterprise applications with Laravel and React while picking up hands-on IT infrastructure experience along the way.
about.p2: At Alphavest Asset Management I wear two hats: I run core IT services — backups, domain administration, support and system maintenance — and I build the firm's business applications. After the KYC compliance platform (Laravel, Livewire), I'm now developing its reporting and digital subscriptions and redemptions solution (Spring Boot, React Native). That lets me own a project end to end, from the server to the interface.
about.intro: Assaad Elaouzi is an IT & Application Developer based in Casablanca, Morocco. At Alphavest Asset Management, Assaad runs core IT services and builds the firm's business applications: a finished KYC platform and a solution, now in progress, for reporting and digital subscriptions and redemptions.

items.desc: Own the company's day-to-day IT operations — backups, domain administration, support and system maintenance. Built the internal KYC application, and now developing the reporting and digital subscriptions and redemptions solution.
Took an internal tool from stakeholder requirements to a working Laravel application — my first build owned end to end in a professional setting.
Final-year engineering project in an industrial environment: worked with plant and laboratory teams to replace a paper-based workflow with a digital one.
Built production interfaces with React.js, turning UX requirements into a responsive product for a travel-tech company.
Built desktop software with Java and JavaFX — internal tools used in day-to-day business operations.

items.title: Reporting, Digital Subscriptions & Redemptions

Subscription and redemption orders placed digitally from a mobile app (React Native)
All operations handled in digital form, end to end
Java Spring Boot REST API backed by PostgreSQL

items.a: Assaad Elaouzi is an IT & Application Developer in Casablanca, Morocco, working at Alphavest Asset Management since January 2026. Assaad holds a degree in Application Development Engineering from FST Tanger and a Full Stack Developer certification from Webforce3.

items.q: What technologies does Assaad Elaouzi work with?
items.a: Laravel, PHP and Livewire; Java and Spring Boot; React.js and React Native; Node.js and Express.js; PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL; plus Python and Git.

Five business systems, with a sixth in progress: a KYC platform and a reporting and digital subscriptions and redemptions solution for Alphavest Asset Management, a laboratory management system for OCP Group, a project evaluation platform at Forvis Mazars, a tour booking platform at DEVTI Technologie, and desktop tools at Gretin Innovation.

items.q: How can I contact Assaad Elaouzi?
items.a: By email at elaouzi.assaadpro@gmail.com, by phone or WhatsApp at +212 645 609 313, or on LinkedIn. Assaad is based in Casablanca, Morocco.
